pr_title: Fix autocompletion not working for return values of some methods
pr_body:
This commit fixes #78820.
This issue is because the return values of some methods are always inferred as `Variant` by script editor.
So, I updated `_guess_identifier_type` to use the annotated/inferred type if available.
pr_comments: Postponed to 4.3 as this is not a critical bug and some work is needed on this PR.

I think my PR #85224 tries to solve the same problem, but instead of always using the annotated type, it checks whether the assigned type is compatible to the annotated type and if that is the case it uses the assigned type. This would allow for type narrowing through the assignment.

issue_context.title: Autocompletion does not work for Dictionary.get() return value
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0.3-stable

### System information

Windows 11, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650

### Issue description

When I assigned Dictionary.get() return value to a typed variable, autocompletion dialog did not show up.

### Steps to reproduce

Please try the following script. Autocompletion dialog is not shown up for `my_class_get` even if typing ".my_" or something.
```gdscript
extends Node

class MyClass:
	var my_var


	func my_func():
		pass


var dic:={
	"a":MyClass.new(),
}


func _ready():
	var my_class_get:MyClass=dic.get("a",MyClass.new())
	my_class_get	# autocompletion does not work
	var my_class_bracket:MyClass=dic["a"]
	my_class_bracket	# autocompletion works
```

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A
comments:
`Array.front()` and `Array.back()` have the same issue.
```
	var array:Array=[MyClass.new()]
	var my_class_array_bracket:MyClass=array[0]
	my_class_array_bracket	# autocompletion works
	var my_class_array_front:MyClass=array.front()
	my_class_array_front	# autocompletion does not work
	var my_class_array_back:MyClass=array.back()
	my_class_array_back	# autocompletion does not work
```

review_comments:
```suggestion
			if (r_type.type.is_variant() && weak_type.type_source != GDScriptParser::DataType::UNDETECTED) {
```

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/6588a4a29af1621086feac0117d5d4d37af957fd/modules/gdscript/gdscript_parser.h#L145

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/6588a4a29af1621086feac0117d5d4d37af957fd/modules/gdscript/gdscript_parser.h#L148

Or maybe even

```suggestion
			if (r_type.type.is_variant()) {
```

I don't think introducing `weak_type` is necessary. Using `id_type` should suffice. You initialize `weak_type` with `id_type` and the only reassignment of `id_type` after that is for type narrowing through `... is ...` constructs. Including this type narrowing in the fallback type makes sense IMHO.
